description: This file implements a signal monitoring provider for the openclaw project, handling configuration, daemon lifecycle, event handling, and message delivery for Signal protocol integration.

classes.name: SignalDaemonHandle
classes.description: Type representing a handle to a Signal daemon process, including methods to stop and handle exit.

methods.name: resolveRuntime
methods.description: Resolves the runtime environment, creating a non-exiting runtime if not provided.

methods.name: mergeAbortSignals
methods.description: Merges two AbortSignals into one, with proper event handling and disposal.

methods.name: createSignalDaemonLifecycle
methods.description: Creates a lifecycle controller for managing the Signal daemon process, including attach, stop, and error retrieval.

methods.name: normalizeAllowList
methods.description: Normalizes an array of string or number entries into a string array.

methods.name: resolveSignalReactionTargets
methods.description: Resolves a SignalReactionMessage into an array of targets with kind and id.

methods.name: isSignalReactionMessage
methods.description: Type guard to check if a message is a valid SignalReactionMessage.

methods.name: shouldEmitSignalReactionNotification
methods.description: Determines if a reaction notification should be emitted based on mode, account, targets, sender, and allowlist.

methods.name: buildSignalReactionSystemEventText
methods.description: Builds a descriptive text for a Signal reaction event.

methods.name: waitForSignalDaemonReady
methods.description: Waits until the Signal daemon is ready, polling with a check function.

methods.name: fetchAttachment
methods.description: Fetches a Signal attachment, saving it locally if within size limits.

methods.name: deliverReplies
methods.description: Delivers reply payloads to a target via Signal, handling text and media.

methods.name: monitorSignalProvider
methods.description: Main function to initialize and run the Signal monitoring provider, managing daemon lifecycle, event handling, and SSE loop.
